stops.title: Di Lis
stops.caption: Pipul we de wet fɔ kam insay.
stops.speech: Di aproval lis gɛt ɔlman we dɔn rejista bɔt dɛn nɔ aprov am yet. Sote dɛn aprov am, i nɔ kin sayn in.

stops.title: Aprov Sɔmbɔdi
stops.caption: Chɛk di branch, dɛn aprov.
stops.speech: Chɛk di branch we dɛn pik ɛn di infɔmeshɔn we dɛn gi, dɛn aprov. Dɛn kin sayn in frɔm dat minit.
